items.title: File Widerspruch against Bürgergeld decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland, Seelower Weg 12, 15344 Musterstrausberg einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter itself states delivery fiction: 'am vierten Tag nach dem Versand (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X)'. Counting calendar days from 19.11: day1=20.11, day2=21.11, day3=22.11, day4=23.11.2026 (Monday) -> deemed delivery. Jobcenter is a social-law body (SGB X), so unlike tax law the delivery day is NOT shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (here it is a Monday anyway). Widerspruch period = one month after delivery under § 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X with §§187,188 BGB counting: the delivery day itself is not counted as day 1; the one-month period ends on the day with the same number one month later, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Brandenburg, so no further shift applies.
